mechanism.es: Consulte al solicitor sobre un cargo de General Sessions retirado, desestimado, abandonado por la fiscalía o terminado en absolución conforme al § 17-1-40. Lleve la resolución y cualquier acuerdo de culpabilidad sobre otros cargos para aplicar la excepción de tarifas correcta.

stopReason.en: Do not treat this guide as a finding that you qualify. Ask the solicitor to resolve missing records, uncertain statutory coverage, prior uses, other charges and the applicable waiting period before signing or paying.

destination.en: Use the Solicitor’s Office in the South Carolina judicial circuit where the offense occurred. Ask its expungement staff for the office-supplied SCCA223A1 GS and its current appointment, payment and signing instructions.

en: Do not file this guide as a court pleading or fill, sign or submit a LegalEase replacement order.
Do not take possession of the official application during the expungement process; arrange your signature with the solicitor’s office.
Do not complete SLED verification, program or official attestations, the solicitor’s consent, judicial findings or a judge’s signature.
Do not use personal checks; confirm the separate certified checks or money orders and payees with the office.
es: No presente esta guía como escrito judicial ni complete, firme o entregue una orden sustitutiva de LegalEase.
No tome posesión de la solicitud oficial durante el proceso; coordine su firma con la oficina del solicitor.
No complete la verificación de SLED, las atestaciones del programa o de funcionarios, el consentimiento del solicitor, las determinaciones judiciales ni la firma de un juez.
No utilice cheques personales; confirme con la oficina los cheques certificados o giros separados y sus beneficiarios.

timing.en: Ask the solicitor to calculate any waiting period from your actual records and confirm readiness before payment or signature. Completion of a program alone does not replace the required official processing.
timing.es: Pida al solicitor que calcule cualquier período de espera a partir de sus documentos y confirme que puede proceder antes del pago o la firma. Completar un programa no sustituye el trámite oficial necesario.

afterNextStep.en: Follow the office’s required verification and attestation sequence. The solicitor handles filing and distribution of the signed order. Ask for confirmation and your available copy after completion; do not assume every record has changed immediately.
afterNextStep.es: Siga la secuencia de verificación y atestación de la oficina. El solicitor se encarga de presentar y distribuir la orden firmada. Pida confirmación y la copia disponible al terminar; no suponga que todos los registros cambian de inmediato.

escalation.en: If the solicitor declines consent, stop this self-help route. Section 17-22-940(I) provides for retained counsel to seek a circuit court determination. Seek legal help for disputed eligibility, conflicting records or immigration consequences; this guide provides no contested court petition.
escalation.es: Si el solicitor deniega su consentimiento, detenga esta vía de autoayuda. El § 17-22-940(I) prevé que un abogado contratado solicite una determinación del tribunal de circuito. Busque ayuda legal ante requisitos disputados, registros contradictorios o consecuencias migratorias; esta guía no proporciona una petición judicial para controversias.

feeSchedule.en: No $250 solicitor administrative fee, unless the charge was dismissed, discharged or nolle prossed as part of the plea arrangement under which the defendant pled guilty and was sentenced to other charges, in which case the $250 applies. No $25 SLED verification fee. No $35 clerk of court filing fee where the charge was discharged, dismissed, nolle prossed or the applicant was acquitted.
feeSchedule.es: No se cobra la tarifa administrativa de $250 del solicitor, salvo cuando el cargo se retiró o desestimó como parte de un acuerdo por el que se declaró culpable y fue condenado por otros cargos. No se cobra la verificación de SLED de $25. No se cobra la tarifa del secretario de $35 cuando el cargo fue retirado, desestimado, abandonado por la fiscalía o terminó en absolución.

feeRelief.en: The § 17-22-940(A)(1) exemption is the operative relief on this route and is automatic rather than discretionary. The solicitor may waive the $250 fee only where a person has been falsely accused as a result of identity theft, § 17-22-940(J). Each solicitor's office also maintains a private donation account which may defray up to fifty per cent of the administrative fee on a first-come first-served basis, § 17-22-940(A)(2).
feeRelief.es: Consulte las excepciones legales antes de pagar. La exención de la tarifa administrativa por acusación falsa derivada de robo de identidad y la cuenta de donaciones que puede cubrir hasta el 50 % de esa tarifa son distintas de las exenciones o reducciones de costos de programas.

Section 44-53-450(B) makes the court's determination that you were dismissed and discharged the whole of the expungement standard, so this is the document the order turns on.

feeSchedule.en: $250 solicitor administrative fee per individual order under § 17-22-940(A), nonrefundable even if the charge is later found ineligible; NO SLED verification fee, because § 17-22-940(E)(1) exempts this route; and the $35 clerk of court filing fee under § 17-22-940(F). Each solicitor's office also maintains a private donation account which may defray up to fifty per cent of the administrative fee on a first-come first-served basis, § 17-22-940(A)(2).
